title: Huilio Mapu ñi zugun the voice of the sites of cultural significance to the mapuche lafkenche of the huilio territory lafkenche ñi mapu ka ñi feyentun
summary: This book is the fruit of a collective and profoundly meaningful process that arose from the heart of the Lafkenche Mapuche territory. Its content gathers the voices of ancestral authorities—Longko, Ngenpin, Machi, Lawentuchefe—and leaders from the 18 Lof and 21 communities that comprise the Kom Pu Lof Self-Convened Territorial Council, who generously shared their knowledge, experiences, and wisdom in numerous meetings and discussions. To them, our sincerest gratitude for opening their spaces and thoughts, and for trusting in this project, which seeks to highlight the spiritual, cultural, and philosophical value of the culturally significant sites of Lafkenmapu.
